g.text: systemd service generated and equal to gateway-up
Installed under the user's systemd (owner runs the commands)
cmd: just gateway-quadlet | pass: prints the Quadlet with the pinned image digest, port and this checkout's path, then the install commands
cmd: just gateway-quadlet-check | pass: prints 'ok' for all nine properties then 'PASS gateway-quadlet'
cmd: just gateway-quadlet | pass: the owner runs the printed mkdir/cp/daemon-reload/start commands; systemctl --user is-active wattson-gateway.service prints 'active'
cmd: just gateway-down | pass: podman ps -a lists no wattson-gateway (after systemctl --user stop wattson-gateway.service)
